task_boundary: Only construct a bounded Step 4 candidate and conflict list; no migration, freeze, production change or Canonical service write.
formal_activation_condition: The parent task determines applicable preceding-gate readiness; this candidate does not waive an actual dependency or issue acceptance.
existing_schema_policy: Use existing contract/registry IDs and field meanings by reference. No new runtime JSON Schema or global registry authority is created.

capability: prepare and maintain naming/namespace candidate definitions
resolve scoped findings and perform delegated review
record scoped decisions when existing evidence and preceding gates are satisfied
delegations.scope: The current Clued repository and current delivery artifacts governed by the inherited 21-step task and explicit scope amendment; only candidate preparation performed here.
delegations.start_condition: This explicit user instruction has been received; each action additionally meets the applicable preceding step gate.
delegations.end_condition: The stated 21-step series is completed, or the user revokes or changes the delegation.
delegations.revocation: Any later user instruction revoking or narrowing this authority takes precedence for subsequent actions; retain prior evidence and history.
delegations.approval_requirement: No repeat user confirmation for actions and decisions already within this delegated task. Effective host permissions, available authenticated service scopes and any actual external authorization requirements still apply.
prohibited_actions: This delegation does not itself mean any step has passed, the architecture is accepted, the structure is frozen, or the project is released.
It does not supply unavailable metadata, convert UNKNOWN into PASS, or permit skipping or silently narrowing the fixed baseline.
It does not assign new platform credentials or bypass denied access.
It does not authorize unrelated work or alteration of preserved historical evidence.
No inference of program Domain issuer authority from management ownership.
No rewriting original Map rows or published historical artifacts.
No migration, freezing or production changes in this candidate-preparation subtask.
